MGDO is an object-oriented library that provides a set of data types and interfaces that encapsulate and manage the physical quantities that are relevant in the data analysis of Ge neutrinoless-double-beta decay experiments.
MGDO is a software library that provides an interface to data objects and analysis tools, allowing the user to easily access the information and to perform data processing.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a common software library can be developed and maintained by a small number of developers and used by multiple experiments.
a software library for Ge-based experiments can be designed to be both flexible and modular, and that the design of such a library should be based on the Object Oriented programming paradigm.
